blurb: Kaya Vineyard & Winery is one of the first and largest vineyards in Dahlonega, located atop a 1,600-foot ridge with mountain and vineyard views. Guests can enjoy wine tasting in the tasting room overlooking the Blue Ridge Mountains. The estate also offers luxury Craftsman style cottages and hosts weddings with elegant spaces and vineyard views.
